layout_and_navigation.structure: Single-page hybrid dashboard with persistent header and three tabs: 'Upload Habitat', 'Interactive Map', 'Animal Analysis'

header.style: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#070E0B]/80 border-b border-[#E6D5B8]/15 z-50)
header.brand_badge: BioDash mark with glowing emerald leaf icon and beige serif typography
header.tab_switcher: Segmented tab pill with sliding emerald active background and smooth layout animation

tab_1_upload.title: Habitat Health Evaluation
tab_1_upload.layout: 2-column bento grid (Left: Dropzone with camera icon & image preview; Right: Real-time/AI Score meter, health summary metrics, ecosystem breakdown, and 'Save Post' action)

tab_2_map.title: Global Habitat Map
tab_2_map.layout: Interactive 2D Leaflet or SVG vector world map styled in dark emerald tones, featuring color-coded pins based on score (0-100), filter by health tier, map legend, and side drawer/modal for saved habitat post details

tab_3_animal.title: Species Identification & Habitat Loss
tab_3_animal.layout: Split view (Photo upload dropzone + AI Species Identification card with taxonomic rank, habitat loss risk meter, threat drivers, and conservation recommendations)

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-[#14221B]/70 border border-[#E6D5B8]/15 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(16,185,129,0.4)] and ambient emerald radial gradients in backgrounds
visual_enhancers.habitat_score_ring: Animated circular SVG progress meter with gradient emerald stroke and score count-up effect
visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle organic noise overlay or biophilic SVG contour background lines

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the fonts Nikolas (serif heading fallback Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display) and LemonMilk (accent display fallback Outfit / Cabinet Grotesk) are cleanly loaded in src/index.css or public/index.html.
Implement real client-side photo processing with simulated or OpenAI/mock AI habitat scoring and animal identification when uploaded.

Include pre-seeded sample data for saved habitat posts with geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude), image, score, location name, and timestamp so the Map tab looks populated and vibrant out of the box.
Allow the user to add new saved posts from the Upload tab, which immediately persists in LocalStorage and updates the Map pins dynamically.

Map implementation should use Leaflet (react-leaflet or raw Leaflet script) or custom interactive SVG canvas with zoom, pan, custom colored marker icons corresponding to scores (Green >= 70, Yellow 40-69, Red < 40), popups, and detail view modal.
Animal tab must accept user image uploads, show an animated scanning line, identify animal species, display habitat loss status (e.g. Vulnerable / Endangered), and present key threats.
Ensure every interactive element has proper `data-testid` attributes as listed in the guidelines.
Strictly follow the dark emerald and warm sand color palette and avoid pure white or plain black containers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphic effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Maintain left-aligned natural reading flow.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, map pin popups.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Ensure high text contrast against dark backgrounds matching APCA standards.
